decisions.reason: As a specialist marine line still shown in 2024, A benefits from substantial engineering and certification investment and the firm is likely to persist unless weakness becomes unmistakably structural.
C sits close to the firm's core interior-lighting business, so despite only modest visible promotion after launch, its fit with the existing range and sunk development costs support keeping it.
Because D was presented as a flagship and focus product, the firm's public commitment and strategic alignment with its stated direction make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

F is somewhat less central to the firm's future narrative than intelligent interior lighting, but as an established multi-model marine product still on the website, management would likely continue backing it rather than admit an early retreat.
